args.title: checkout-api failing health checks after v2.3.1 deploy; rolled back to v2.3.0
args.summary: checkout-api v2.3.1 was failing health checks in production since deploy (unhealthy, error rate 18% across us-east, us-west, eu-west). v2.3.1-rc was also unhealthy in staging. Rolled back checkout-api in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) to v2.3.0, the most recent release that was healthy in production. Follow-up: investigate root cause in v2.3.1 before redeploying.

trace.final:
I rolled checkout-api back to v2.3.0 in all three regions, and it's healthy again. I also opened the SEV2 incident.

- **Cause:** The latest deploy, v2.3.1, was failing health checks in us-east, us-west and eu-west, with an 18% error rate. Its release candidate (v2.3.1-rc) had also failed in staging.
- **Rollback:** v2.3.0 was the most recent release that was healthy in production. Since it's a version that has been healthy before, the rollback didn't need approval.
- **Result:** All three regions are now on v2.3.0, and the error rate has dropped to 0.2%.
- **Incident:** INC-0001 (SEV2, checkout-api) is open and the on-call engineer has been paged. It describes the v2.3.1 failure and the rollback, and recommends finding the root cause before v2.3.1 is deployed again. I wrote the incident before checking the post-rollback status, so it doesn't mention that the service has recovered. You may want to add that.

content.text: Most recent healthy production release is v2.3.0.
